attendance.note: Media-reported for the 2025 debut: close to 7,000 (Ride On) and about 9,000 (Flow); organiser says 'nearly 9,000 attendees and 170+ brands' (seaotter.au/about). 2026 expectation: 10,000 visitors, 2,500 athletes and 120+ exhibitors representing 250+ brands (Australasian Leisure Management, 13 Oct 2026).
